name: SCTKit
prompt: Use skills/needs-analysis/SKILL.md in this checkout to start a SCTKit benchmark. Start from a clinical scenario, hypothesis and new information. Specify the response scale and source of the reference distribution. Ask me one question at a time and save the agreed decisions in my benchmark workspace.
capability: A local scoring adapter supports concordance. Provide an authorized distribution and identify whether it comes from experts or a synthetic reference.

name: CPCKit
prompt: Use skills/needs-analysis/SKILL.md in this checkout to start a CPCKit benchmark. Select the CPC variant first: differential diagnosis, management, text questions or image questions. Ask me one question at a time and save the agreed decisions in my benchmark workspace.
capability: The staged differential adapter accepts diagnosis aliases and uses reciprocal rank. Other variants need their own case and scoring contracts.

name: RCQKit
prompt: Use skills/needs-analysis/SKILL.md in this checkout to start a RCQKit benchmark. Describe the setting for open clinical questions and the source of the reference expectations. Ask me one question at a time and save the agreed decisions in my benchmark workspace.
capability: The library includes RCQ item and rating contracts. Identify the reference source and the origin of each judgment.

name: MedAgentKit
prompt: Use skills/needs-analysis/SKILL.md in this checkout to start a MedAgentKit benchmark. Describe the clinical workflow, permitted FHIR tools and the chart state used to judge completion. Ask me one question at a time and save the agreed decisions in my benchmark workspace.
capability: The local FHIR example builds and runs synthetic chart tasks. The original MedAgentBench has its own runtime and access requirements.

name: RadiologyKit
prompt: Use skills/needs-analysis/SKILL.md in this checkout to start a RadiologyKit benchmark. Define the intended report task and specify the authorized images, reference reports and report-quality judge. Ask me one question at a time and save the agreed decisions in my benchmark workspace.
capability: The skills support report-task planning. Implement or supply the report scorer before execution.

name: Medical images
prompt: Use skills/needs-analysis/SKILL.md in this checkout to start a Medical images benchmark. Specify the modality, input images and expected answer. Identify the authorized source of the images and labels. Ask me one question at a time and save the agreed decisions in my benchmark workspace.
capability: The multimodal example exercises a local image attachment. Classification and closed-answer questions use task-specific answer profiles.

name: Guided assistant
prompt: Use skills/needs-analysis/SKILL.md in this checkout to start a custom benchmark. Start with my clinical task and intended use. Help me specify the inputs, expected output, reference material and scoring contract. Ask me one question at a time and save the agreed decisions in my benchmark workspace.
capability: The implementation plan records which data loader and scorer are available and any additional code needed.
